note: Ceilings for the live run owned by P32. Tokens are counted from native logs; money is not computed here (no vendor price table, no subscription model). The operator multiplies the token ceilings by current vendor prices or watches the weekly limit.
axesNote: Separate axes (jev on; minimal-development on) form wave w3 and are planned from the axes flags of the scenarios.
stopRules: Check the weekly usage before every wave; stop the wave when the operator-set limit is reached.
Stop the wave after two consecutive runs marked overBudget.
Never start a wave without an explicit go from the human (P32).
cacheNote: Claude Code keeps the cache for an hour (ephemeral_1h_input_tokens) and the tools and the unchanged system prompt are shared by both arms, so warm runs cannot be told from cold ones and are not planned: one cell per scenario, arm and repetition. The `cache` value stays cold for compatibility with old records and means no deliberate warm-up; the real cache hit is read from the first request of the run (`firstRequest`). warmWithinSec is kept only to read old warm records.
waveNote: wq is the shortened wave: five scenarios moved out of w1 (ambiguous, russian, multiple, long-skill, unavailable), both arms, jev off, minimal-development off, `repetitions` of the wave (3) instead of the common one. Run it alone with `plan --wave wq`.
